data.long_meaning: Arabic root 'ibtakara' means 'to strive, to try, to compete'. The name Ibtikar refers to someone who puts in great effort and excels in their endeavors. The name Ibtikar carries the meaning “To strive, exert effort” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Ibtikar usually hope their child will grow to embody to strive, exert effort and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: The name Ibtikar is deeply spiritual, reminding us of the importance of striving for knowledge and understanding in our lives. It is a name that encourages us to be ambitious and to reach for the stars, both in our personal and spiritual journeys.
data.etymology: Ibtikar belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “To strive, exert effort.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Ibtikar total 7, giving a life-path number of 7. Number 7 is linked with Ketu and with the qualities of reflection, wisdom and inner depth.
